biotools.summary: KOnezumi-AID is a command-line tool designed for gRNA design in Target-AID mediated genome editing, facilitating the creation of multiplex knockouts by inducing premature termination codons or exon skipping. It supports both mouse and human genomes and offers batch processing capabilities.
